goal: Sandbox és biztonság erősítés: VM sandbox Node.js kód végrehajtáshoz, network isolation, RBAC profil minden agent-nek, resource quotas (CPU/memory limit per sandbox).
archiveReason: Sandbox security hardening track was complete and has been archived from the live backlog.

phases.name: Phase 1: VM Sandbox
phases.description: Node.js vm-based code isolation with pool, resource limits
tasks: [x] Sandbox pool: pre-warm, reuse, reset between executions
[x] Security: validateCode blocks process, require, import, Function

phases.name: Phase 2: Network Isolation
tasks: [x] Localhost blocking + rate limiting per hostname

phases.name: Phase 3: RBAC Hardening
phases.description: Enhanced permission system with runtime enforcement
tasks: [x] 6 profiles: ADMIN, DEVELOPER, RESEARCHER, EVALUATOR, ROBOTKEZ, READONLY
[x] Per-agent tool access control + network domain whitelisting
[x] Cost tracking with daily limits per profile
[x] Violation recording with severity levels + stats
[x] Agent name pattern matching for auto-profile assignment

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring + Dashboard + CLI
tasks: [x] Sandbox stats widget + Network policy widget + Violations table
[x] RBAC map visualization with color-coded profiles

expectedOutput: Resource quotas: CPU/memory limit + cost tracking
